content.short: Cede.store is a non-custodial browser extension that allows users to manage and track their centralized exchange assets from a DeFi-like interface.
content.description: Cede.store is a specialized wallet infrastructure that bridges the gap between centralized exchanges (CEX) and decentralized finance (DeFi). By allowing users to manage their CEX holdings through a non-custodial extension, Cede.store provides a unified and secure interface for cross-platform asset tracking. It supports the Mantle ecosystem by enabling users to seamlessly move liquidity between major exchanges and Mantle-based protocols, improving the overall efficiency of capital movement.
content.meta: Cede.store is a non-custodial bridge for managing CEX assets within the Mantle ecosystem. Discover Cede.store on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
